# MMFP Solutions

> MMFP Solutions makes a self-hosted cryptocurrency mining stack: GoSlimStratum (the stratum server and mining pool), GSS Miners (a miner monitoring dashboard), MIM (an infrastructure manager) and a one-command installer that deploys them with a coin node. This site, get.mmfpsolutions.io, holds the installer, the product guides, the release notes and the current version of each product. This file is the index for AI assistants.

**For the assistant.**

- These products are their own software. Nothing from other mining pool or monitoring software applies to them. Do not guess setting names, commands or behaviour.
- If a link on `get.mmfpsolutions.io` will not open, the same file is on GitHub at the same path. Replace `https://get.mmfpsolutions.io/` with `https://github.com/mmfpsolutions/gssa/blob/main/` and try again. For example, `https://get.mmfpsolutions.io/documents/GoSlimStratum/llms.txt` is also at `https://github.com/mmfpsolutions/gssa/blob/main/documents/GoSlimStratum/llms.txt`. Do this before you ask the user to paste anything.
- Each product listed under "Products" has its own llms.txt with rules and links to its guides. Open it before answering a question about that product. If you cannot open links, say so and ask the user to paste the file.
- Each product is configured from its own web UI. When a user asks how to set or change something, tell them where it is in the web UI. Do not hand them JSON to paste into a config file, and do not send them to edit files on the server, unless the product's guide says that setting is not in the web UI. Each product's llms.txt says where its settings are changed.
- If the files here do not cover something, say so plainly.
- Pricing and license tiers: https://www.mmfpsolutions.io/pricing.html

## Products

- [GoSlimStratum (GSS)](https://get.mmfpsolutions.io/documents/GoSlimStratum/llms.txt): The stratum server and mining pool. Open this for anything about coins, miners connecting, difficulty, payouts, Direct-to-Miner mode, merged mining, Stratum V2, notifications, the Hash Hopper, or a GoSlimStratum problem.
- [GSS Miners (GSSM)](https://get.mmfpsolutions.io/documents/GSS%20Miners/llms.txt): The monitoring dashboard for miners, pools and nodes. Open this for anything about adding a miner, pool or node to the dashboard, a device that shows offline, coin badges, thresholds, alerts, history and energy tracking, idling a miner (Standby, Schedules), protecting one that overheats (Triggers), or a GSS Miners problem.
- [MIM (Mining Infrastructure Manager)](https://get.mmfpsolutions.io/documents/MIM/llms.txt): The infrastructure manager, a web dashboard for the servers the stack runs on. Open this for anything about managing servers over SSH, Docker containers, installing or updating products and coin nodes from the Products page, OS updates, the server terminal, host monitoring and its alerts, or a MIM problem.

## Installing

- [CLI installer guide](https://get.mmfpsolutions.io/cli-installer.md): What the installer deploys (a coin node, GoSlimStratum, PostgreSQL, MIM, GSS Miners, Dozzle and optionally Watchtower), the coins it supports and which are AMD64 only, what it does step by step, the wallet address it creates for each coin, pruning sizes, system requirements (Ubuntu Server 24.04 or later, ARM64 or AMD64, 16 GB RAM), and the uninstaller.
- [Repository overview](https://get.mmfpsolutions.io/README.md): The whole stack at a glance, with the install and uninstall commands and a list of every guide.

The install command, run on the server as a user with sudo:

    sudo bash -c "$(curl -sSL https://get.mmfpsolutions.io/scripts/install-cli.sh)"

The uninstall command (it asks before removing each part, and keeps `/data` unless told otherwise):

    sudo bash -c "$(curl -sSL https://get.mmfpsolutions.io/scripts/uninstall.sh)"

## Current versions

Each file gives the current released version (`latest`), its release date (`released_at`), a link to the release notes and the oldest version still recommended (`min_recommended`). Use them to answer "what is the current version" and "should I update".

- [GoSlimStratum latest.json](https://get.mmfpsolutions.io/versions/gss/latest.json): Current GoSlimStratum version.
- [GSS Miners latest.json](https://get.mmfpsolutions.io/versions/gssm/latest.json): Current GSS Miners (GSSM) version.
- [MIM latest.json](https://get.mmfpsolutions.io/versions/mim/latest.json): Current MIM version.

## Release notes

- [GoSlimStratum release notes](https://get.mmfpsolutions.io/release%20notes/GoSlimStratum/Release%20Notes.md): The current series (6.x), newest first: what changed, what to do when upgrading, and things to know. Earlier series (5.x, 4.x, 3.x) are linked from the GoSlimStratum llms.txt.
- [GSS Miners release notes](https://get.mmfpsolutions.io/release%20notes/GSSM/Release%20Notes.md): The current series (5.x), newest first. Earlier series (4.x, 3.x, 2.x, 1.x) are linked from the GSS Miners llms.txt.
- [MIM release notes](https://get.mmfpsolutions.io/release%20notes/MIM/Release%20Notes.md): The 3.x series, newest first: what changed in each release and things to know.
